text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali looks at draft of law called "tax rights and duties code". The draft reinforces tax collection measures. It is to be submitted to a cabinet meeting later.
- Senegalese Foreign Affairs Minister Moustapha Niasse received by the president on Wednesday and says Tunisia is an example for Africa and the Third World.
- Morocco and Tunisia on Tuesday started discussing cooperation at a joint committee in Rabat.
- Tunisia produces 85 percent of its needs in milk.
